data_fields.name: depotHoldingLimit
data_fields.donor_constant: group maxdepotitems if non-zero, else depotFreeLimit 2000 / depotPremiumLimit 15000

best_idea: Work out how many items fit and what the whole move will do before changing any state, then commit once and report the part that did not fit.
decision_why: Plan-then-commit move with clamp-and-report partial fit and one holding ledger fits server-verified bag, bank and loot moves; fix the swap-before-recheck and the ignored trade leg; bag slots and depot limits belong in item and tier data, not engine code.
acceptance: A server test moves 150 potions into a 2-slot bag holding one 90-stack and one free slot: 110 move, stacks of 100 and 100, source keeps 40, reply says bag full without failing the whole move.
